$comment: Where a run has got to, contract 1.11.0. `phase` is a closed vocabulary because the Run detail page renders a fixed set of steps; a free string would make the page show whatever the daemon happened to say. This message also carries the run's *liveness* on Central's side — `last_event_at` — but note the split (ADR 0029 sec 4): the idle decision is the daemon's, because the daemon has the event stream, and this column exists so the page can say 'last activity: 3 minutes ago'.

commit_sha.$comment: Reported once, with `phase: checked_out`, so the Run detail page can answer 'which version of the code did this run actually execute'.

waiting_for_input.$comment: True when the agent asked a question and is blocked on a person. A run in this state renews its lease and accrues no execution timeout, and it occupies `max_waiting` rather than `max_concurrent`.
